newsitem.title: UK: NFC in talks to sell Lynx to management.
newsitem.headline: NFC in talks to sell Lynx to management.

text.p: British distribution group NFC Plc said on Monday it was in discussions with NatWest Ventures Limited which may lead to a management buyout of its parcels operation, Lynx.
"It is the present intention that the management of Lynx will participate in the purchase of the business," NFC said in a statement.
NFC said NatWest Ventures were currently undertaking due diligence and it would therefore be several weeks before a contract was signed.
Lynx had a net asset value of around 25 million stg on September 30, 1996. It had a turnover during that year of 94 million stg.
